title: m1 row-parallel cpu develop
description:
M1 commit (b): port the audit's bench shape (bench/bench.cpp —
read-only reference, never modified) into core as a doctest so the
serial-vs-parallel measurement runs on the host with the byte-exact
gate asserted in the same run.

bench_develop.cpp decodes the real clip's frame 0 once
(RAWEDIT_REALCLIP=1 gate, same as test_temporal/test_optical_sync),
decimates to 1280x720 with the audit's stride arithmetic, and times
developThumbnail (the developCpu pipeline) serial vs parallel:
warm-up pass, then N=9 repetitions, median, for the audit's three
anchor cases — neutral, AgX, AgX + managed 709 LUT 33 (DisplayLook
binding, Rec709OETF in/out).

Asserted (honest): the serial and parallel outputs are
byte-identical (memcmp) for every case — the M1 acceptance gate.
Reported, never asserted (host core count varies): MESSAGE lines of
the form 'M1 bench: case=agx 1280x720 serial_ms=X parallel_ms=Y
s
changed: test: develop bench serial vs parallel
